name: Commerce One Holdings Inc.
summary: Commerce One Holdings Inc. provides solutions that let e-commerce operators start and run businesses in Japan. It offers futureshop, a SaaS e-commerce platform, package software for unified order and inventory management across multiple stores, and tools such as ECnote and Fast Connector. It also provides web media, influencer marketing and social commerce services. Incorporated in 2006, it has its base in Chiyoda, Japan.
